# City of Echo, Oregon

> Official website for Echo, Oregon—a historic Oregon Trail settlement in Umatilla County featuring community information, local attractions, and municipal government resources.

Echo is a small city in northeastern Oregon with deep roots in Oregon Trail history and Fort Henrietta heritage. The site serves as the primary digital hub for residents and visitors seeking information about the community's history, attractions, government services, and events.

## Key Topics

- Echo, Oregon
- Oregon Trail
- Fort Henrietta
- Umatilla County
- Historic Downtown
- City Council
- Community Center
- Local Heritage
- Visitor Guide
- Municipal Government
- Historic Sites
- Town History
- Settlement Origins
- Native American History
- Downtown Restoration

## About Echo

- [About Us](https://echo-oregon.com/about-us): Overview of Echo, Oregon's geography, history, and community information
- [Echo at a Glance](https://echo-oregon.com/echo-at-a-glance): Quick overview of Echo with demographics, climate, attractions, and visitor info
- [History of Echo](https://echo-oregon.com/history): Detailed history of Echo including Oregon Trail origins and Fort Henrietta
- [Historic Downtown](https://echo-oregon.com/historic-downtown): Historic downtown Echo with National Register buildings and community center

## Attractions & Recreation

- [Attractions](https://echo-oregon.com/attractions): Local attractions including Oregon Trail sites, museums, and historic landmarks
- [Community Center](https://echo-oregon.com/community-center): Echo Community Center event venue rental with facilities and amenities info
- [Echo Hills Golf Course](https://echo-oregon.com/echo-hills-golf-course): Municipal 9-hole golf course with membership rates and greens fees
- [City Events](https://echo-oregon.com/city-events): Calendar of Echo annual events and community activities

## City Government & Services

- [Departments](https://echo-oregon.com/departments): City government departments directory with contact information
- [Agendas & Minutes](https://echo-oregon.com/agendas-minutes): City Council and Budget Committee meeting agendas and minutes archive
- [Planning](https://echo-oregon.com/planning): Comprehensive plans, zoning, water facilities, and municipal policy documents

## News & Communications

- [News & Notices](https://echo-oregon.com/news-and-notices): Municipal announcements, emergency services, and city updates
- [City Publications](https://echo-oregon.com/city-publications): City newsletter archive and government communications publications

## Optional

- [Floral Displays](https://echo-oregon.com/floral-displays): City beautification through floral displays and America in Bloom participation
